subject: MAP kickoff: MedNova POC benchmarks & owners
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Bianchi <tom@mednova.com>; Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mednova.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: MedNova POC benchmarks & owners

Hi Tom and Elena —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, we want to lock in a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the POC so we can validate throughput, latency, and quality against your clinical note extraction use case. Attached is a first draft MAP and a short benchmark spec. Key things we want to confirm in this kickoff:

- Success criteria (what passes/fails the POC)
- Benchmark plan (data subsets, prompts, quality gates, performance targets)
- Owners (who owns prompts, evals, infra checks, and security signoffs)
- Timeline to decision (close target + gating checkpoints)

Preliminary suggestions (from our side):
- Success: 1) avg latency <= 350 ms at 95th pct under your baseline load, 2) extraction F1 >= 0.88 on sampled EHR notes, 3) no PII leakage per synthetic probe set.
- Benchmark sprint: week 1 — dataset prep and baseline runs; week 2 — prompt refinement and eval runs; week 3 — production-ish throughput test and joint review.
- Owners: Tom/Elena to own dataset access and clinical acceptance criteria; Rachel (me) to own MAP cadence and roll-up; Priyom to own eval harness and metrics; Dev to own runtime config and perf tuning; Stephanie to own customer success checkpoints.

Please confirm or amend owners below and let us know any hard constraints on the proposed timelines. If that looks good we'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff call with the broader engineering and security teams.

Attachments: MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), benchmark_spec.md (benchmark details)

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Consultant | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192


From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bianchi <tom@mednova.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mednova.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: MedNova POC benchmarks & owners

Rachel — thanks, this looks solid. Couple of clarifications from the eval side:

1) For the F1 target: we'll run both strict and relaxed extraction matches. Suggest F1 >= 0.88 (relaxed) and >= 0.82 (strict) as the gates so clinical review has a fallback.
2) I'll add an item to the benchmark_spec.md for prompt ablation (3 prompt templates + temperature sweep) so we can measure stability.

I'll prepare the eval harness and a Jenkins job to push runs to the dedicated pool. I'm fine being primary owner for metrics and reports.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: MedNova POC benchmarks & owners

Rachel / Priyom —

This is helpful, thank you. A few notes from the MedNova side:

- Owners: I'll own clinical acceptance and supplies of the annotated sample (we will provide ~1k de-identified notes). Tom will coordinate infra access and SSO for the private test environment.
- Timeline: the end of May close target is tight for our security review. Can we push final decision to early June if needed? We do want to follow your 3-week bench sprint once access is granted.
- Success criteria: add a secondary gate for hallucination probes (<= 2% hallucination rate on synthetic probes).

We can do a 30-minute kickoff on Wednesday 05/05 at 10:00 AM PT — Tom and I will invite our security engineer for the access checklist item.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Clinical Data | MedNova Health
elena.ruiz@mednova.com

Joined the kickoff and the notes look good — thanks everyone. Action items I have:

- Upload sample set to Drive (MedNova_Samples_v1/). ETA 05/04 EOD (Elena confirmed).
- Security engineer to share SSO checklist during the call; possible delay to final decision moved to 06/07 as discussed.
- We'll validate the seeding script for synthetic probes and share expected probe injection points by Friday.

Rachel/Priyom/Dev — can you share the first-pass eval run (strict/relaxed) to the shared drive + HubSpot link after you run it? We'll use that for clinical review.

Tom Bianchi
